Drift Hunters is a free-to-play 3D arcade drifting and driving simulator created by Ilya Kaminetsky (Studionum43). 
Overview and Gameplay
Core Goal: Drift cars across open courses and tracks to rack up points rather than racing for traditional lap times.
Scoring: Long, continuous, and controlled slides increase your score multipliers.
Platforms: Accessible via CrazyGames and other web browsers, as well as mobile versions on iOS and Android. 
Microsoft Store
 +3
Cars and Customization
Vehicle Lineup: Features 26 fully customizable cars, starting from a Toyota AE86 up to high-performance models like the Nissan GT-R and Porsche 911 GT.
Tuning: Players can tweak suspension, brake balance, front camber, and rear offset, alongside performance upgrades for the engine, turbo, gearbox, and brakes. 
Controls
Accelerate: W or Up Arrow
Steering: A and D or Left and Right Arrows
Brake: S or Down Arrow
Handbrake: Spacebar (essential for initiating slides)
Camera View: C
